dct_title_s: L'Africa divisa ne'suoi Principali Stati Di Nuova Projezione
dct_description_sm: Based on Janvier's map (see NOR 0104). "Fairly accurate geographically and unknown parts of the country are marked as such instead of being dotted with fictitious places"; Prime meridian through Ferro Island.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997. Map 0099, p. 116.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0099.
